cefrAlignment: Matches B1: single-sentence statements with present continuous, present perfect passive and 'is being' passive about concrete scenes, a suitable bridge from B1 grammar to TOEIC Part 1.
examFidelity: Faithful to TOEIC Part 1 (four unprinted statements, choose the best description, 6 questions in the real test per exams.ts); I read each SVG and confirmed exactly one statement per picture is true (warehouse B, restaurant B, meeting D, park C) and that the alt text matches the drawings.
fixes: Grammar table: softened 'so a person must be in the photo' to 'usually needs to be' (there are known exceptions such as 'items are being displayed').
Quick check Q3: the correct option repeated the prompt word for word ('A bus is parked by the side of the road'); reworded to 'There is a bus at the side of the road' so learners must match meaning.
Sound-discrimination item 6: explanation now says 'short vowel sound' instead of 'short sound'.
openConcerns: The photos are simple drawings, not photographs; real Part 1 photos are more detailed.
Minimal pairs (lamp/lamb, ship/sheep) depend on TTS clarity; a specialist should listen to check the final /p/ in 'lamp' is audible.
learnerOutcome: A learner who completes the lesson can scan a picture for people, actions and objects before listening and reject Part 1 statements that use similar sounds, the wrong action or 'being' passives in scenes with no people.
